answer: Because the anchor calculation reruns each epoch, the gale weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the willow settlement publishes the resulting shares. A tight ring of 41 clones thus holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 51% independent neighbours on the funding graph. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
